summary: Re-test after Gaji PIN reset bug fix (design v2 — NO portal PIN). All 23 backend tests PASS including two dedicated bug-fix cases (test_f: /gaji-pin/reset-apply and test_g: /set-pin fallback) that confirm herliana can create a NEW Gaji PIN after susanto approves reset WITHOUT the old PIN — the previous 'PIN Gaji lama salah' error is gone. Full end-to-end Playwright flow also passes: (1) herliana logs in and lands directly on hrd-home (no portal PIN); (2) first click on hrd-card-gaji opens create-PIN dialog (5678 set); (3) after Lock + wrong PIN the hrd-gajipin-failed box + hrd-gajipin-request-reset button appear; (4) susanto (separate context) sees hrd-approve-notif, opens hrd-approve-dialog, clicks Setujui (no Data Gaji card visible for susanto); (5) herliana reloads → hrd-reset-notif visible AND clicking hrd-card-gaji opens hrd-reset-apply-dialog directly; (6) saving new PIN 4321 succeeds with NO 'PIN lama salah' error and new PIN unlocks hrd-gaji-area with all 4 tabs (slip/karyawan/email/settings). Heri sees only Dokumen HRD + Log Akses (no Data Gaji card). Excel import produces 5 slips and Wawan take_home = 8,138,000; PDF endpoint returns application/pdf.

minor.issue: Endpoint is guarded by _can_manage_pin so only herliana can request (design-correct), but note the earlier code review comment about heri being blocked here is now fine. Also /gaji-pin/approve-reset (no request_id) approves ALL pending via update_many — acceptable but multi-request UX may be confusing.
pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` but state-sharing tests must run serial. Runs with `-n 0` deterministically pass 23/23.

hrd.py openGaji frontend routing: when gaji_reset_approved=True, hrd-card-gaji opens hrd-reset-apply-dialog directly — verified working. Users can't accidentally hit the verify-PIN path in that state.
server.py CORS still allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — permissive; fine for preview but should be tightened in prod.
SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME default in deps.py is 'susanto' which now matches the design (previously misaligned). Good.
hrd.py has_perm blocks super_admin from GAJI_GROUP — correctly enforced. Verified via /api/hrd/employees, /payslips, /settings returning 403 for susanto.

rca of the issue: Original bug: herliana couldn't set a new Gaji PIN after susanto approved a reset — server returned 'PIN Gaji lama salah'. Root cause: /api/hrd/set-pin unconditionally verified current_pin when pin_hash existed. Fix: set_pin now checks db.hrd_pin_resets for status='approved'; if present, it accepts new PIN without current_pin and marks the approved requests as 'resolved'. In parallel /api/hrd/gaji-pin/reset-apply provides the explicit reset path used by the frontend. Both paths verified in test_f and test_g.
